Overview

The Flagship 36-Hour Innovation Hackathon

Build for Bharat 2.0 is a flagship national-level hackathon that brings together students, developers, innovators, designers, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts to identify real-world challenges and build impactful, technology-driven solutions.

The hackathon is designed to move beyond ideas and encourage participants to transform real-world problems into functional, scalable and meaningful solutions using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Development, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity and other emerging technologies.

Participants will have the freedom to identify relevant problems, research their domain, source appropriate datasets and develop solutions that create measurable value for real-world users and stakeholders.

The Challenge

The world is generating massive amounts of data, while organisations, industries, governments, educational institutions and individuals continue to face complex challenges that require intelligent and data-driven solutions.

Participants are challenged to identify a real-world problem within areas such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Data Science and Analytics
  • Talent and Workforce Intelligence
  • Skill Development and Career Intelligence
  • Recruitment and Human Resources
  • Education and Employability
  • Business and Industry
  • Healthcare and Public Services
  • Financial Technology
  • Cybersecurity
  • Sustainability and Smart Solutions
  • Any other relevant technology-driven domain

Teams must identify a genuine problem, understand its stakeholders, acquire relevant data and develop a technology-driven solution that addresses the problem effectively.

The focus is not merely on building a model or dashboard, but on demonstrating how technology and data can be converted into a practical solution with real-world impact.

Hackathon Structure

Round 1 — Online Registration & Idea Submission

Participants will register their teams through Unstop and submit a PPT presenting their proposed solution.

The submission should clearly explain:

  • Problem being addressed
  • Target users and stakeholders
  • Proposed solution
  • Innovation and uniqueness
  • Data sources and proposed datasets
  • Technical approach
  • Expected outcomes
  • Potential real-world impact

Teams are encouraged to conduct sufficient research and validate the relevance of their proposed problem before submission.

Registration & PPT Submission Deadline: 20 September 2026

All submissions will be evaluated by the organising team/judging panel based on the quality of the problem, innovation, feasibility, proposed approach, potential impact and overall solution vision.

Shortlisting for the Final Round

The shortlisted teams will be announced on 25 September 2026.

Only shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the final on-campus hackathon.

Round 2 — 36-Hour On-Campus Hackathon

The shortlisted teams will come to Chandigarh University for the final 36-hour offline hackathon.

  • Dates: 7–8 October 2026
  • Duration: 36 Hours
  • Mode: Offline / On-Campus
  • Venue: Chandigarh University

During the 36-hour finale, teams will work intensively to convert their proposed ideas into functional prototypes.

Participants will be expected to:

Research → Build → Test → Iterate → Validate → Present

Teams will have the opportunity to refine their solutions, work with their teammates, receive guidance where available and present their final implementations before the judging panel.

Participation Fee

Participation Fee: ₹400 per team

The ₹400 fee is applicable for participation in the hackathon.

Teams registering through Round 1 will complete their registration and PPT submission through Unstop. Only teams shortlisted for Round 2 will proceed to the final on-campus hackathon at Chandigarh University.

The fee details and payment instructions will be communicated to shortlisted teams as part of the Round 2 qualification process.

Dataset Freedom

Participants are not restricted to any specific dataset.

Teams are encouraged to identify and use their own relevant datasets based on the problem they choose to solve. These may include publicly available datasets, open-data sources, APIs or other legally usable data sources.

Teams are responsible for ensuring that their selected data is relevant, reliable, appropriately sourced and suitable for their proposed solution.

The choice and quality of data, along with how effectively it is used to solve the identified problem, will form an important part of the evaluation.

What Are We Looking For?

Build for Bharat 2.0 is looking for solutions that demonstrate:

  • Real Problem: A genuine and clearly defined problem affecting identifiable users or stakeholders.
  • Innovation: A solution that introduces a meaningful improvement over existing approaches.
  • Data & Technology: Effective use of relevant data, analytics, AI/ML or other technologies.
  • Feasibility: A solution that can realistically be implemented beyond the hackathon.
  • Impact: Clear potential to create measurable value for users, organisations or society.
  • Scalability: The potential for the solution to grow beyond a prototype.
  • Execution: A functional prototype demonstrating that the idea can actually be implemented.

Who Can Participate?

Build for Bharat 2.0 is open to students, developers, designers, researchers, innovators, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts who are passionate about solving real-world problems.

Participants are encouraged to build multidisciplinary teams combining expertise in:

Artificial Intelligence | Machine Learning | Data Science | Software Development | Web & App Development | Cybersecurity | Cloud Computing | UI/UX | Product Development | Business & Entrepreneurship

Important Dates

  • Registration & PPT Submission: Till 20 September 2026
  • Shortlisted Teams Announcement: 25 September 2026
  • Final On-Campus Hackathon: 7–8 October 2026
  • Final Round Duration: 36 Hours
  • Final Round Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Chandigarh University
  • Participation Fee: ₹400 per team

From Idea to Impact

Build for Bharat 2.0 is not just about presenting an idea. It is about taking a real problem, understanding it deeply, using data and technology intelligently and building something that can make a difference.

Bring your problem-solving mindset.
Bring your technical skills.
Bring your team.
Build something that matters.

36 Hours. Real Problems. Real Solutions.

Build for Bharat 2.0

Where Ideas Become Impact.
